title: Palantir Q1 2026 Earnings Deep Dive — AI Revenue Acceleration
transcript: Today we're going to break down Palantir's incredible Q1 2026 earnings report. Revenue came in at 892 million dollars, beating estimates by 12 percent. The AI Platform, or AIP, is now generating over 60 percent of commercial revenue. Government contracts are stable but the real growth story is in the commercial sector. The stock is trading at 45x forward earnings which is expensive but arguably justified given the 35 percent revenue growth rate. Key takeaway: PLTR is becoming the de facto AI infrastructure provider for enterprises. Their net dollar retention rate hit 135 percent, meaning existing customers are spending 35 percent more year over year.
